description: Video analyzer – extracts scenes, transcripts, entities, anomalies, and classification from video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, etc.)

Description.description: A comprehensive description of the overall video content and context

TranscriptSummary.description: A high-level summary of the complete video transcript

AnomalyOrFraudDetected.description: Description of any anomaly or fraudulent activity detected across the entire video; null if none

Classification.description: Hierarchical classification of the video content as 'Category > Subcategory > Tag', e.g. 'Security > Surveillance > NightFootage'

Shots.description: Per-shot analysis of the video; each entry represents one scene or shot

Description.description: A detailed description of the scene or visual content in this shot

Transcript.description: Speech transcript captured during this shot

KeyPhrases.description: Key phrases extracted from speech or on-screen text in this shot

NamedEntities.description: Named entities identified in this shot as a comma-separated list of 'Text (Category)' pairs, e.g. 'Alice (Person), London (Location)'

IdentifiedObjects.description: Objects visually identified in this shot

PiiData.description: Any personally identifiable information detected in this shot (faces, license plates, ID numbers); null if none

AnyAnomaly.description: Description of any anomaly detected in this shot (unusual behavior, tampering, unauthorized access); null if none
